blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday inspected the newly constructed Felipe Abrigo Memorial Hospital (FAMH) in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, which was rebuilt after being damaged by Typhoon Yolanda in 2013. The hospital features modern facilities and medical equipment, including an emergency room, operating rooms, wards, and a dental clinic, to address the various healthcare needs of patients. It is set to fully reopen on Oct. 8, bringing better and more comprehensive medical care closer to the people, particularly those in remote and far-flung communities.
